node.statement: Entrywise amplification gives h_{2n}(Z)=(h_n(Z_ij)); contractive target corner compression yields ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=max_ij||h_n(Z_ij)||>=a_n max_ij||Z_ij||. Combining with the preceding bound gives ||h_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n||Z||/2, and taking the infimum gives a_{2n}>=a_n/2.
